turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue in STE]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    AS3 --> AS4[This is a finding, not a draft]
    AS4 --> STOP1([Stop])

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> WAIT[Wait for answer]
    WAIT --> B

    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C{Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path}
    C -->|HUMAN| CT[Run the speak test]
    C -->|MACHINE| D{Floor passes?}
    CT --> D

    D -->|No, three or fewer gaps| Q1[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    D -->|No, four or more gaps| Q2[Ask three largest gaps]
    Q2 --> Q3[Assume the remaining gaps]
    Q1 --> WAIT2[Wait for answer]
    Q3 --> WAIT2
    WAIT2 --> C

    D -->|Yes| E[Find the core task]
    E --> E2[Keep load-bearing context]
    E2 --> E3[Keep necessary constraints]
    E3 --> E4[State each format and file path]
    E4 --> E5[Run the floor test]

    E5 --> F{Cut removed specification?}
    F -->|Yes| F1[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    F1 --> F2[Revert the cut]
    F2 --> E5
    F -->|No| G{Two consecutive Cut: nothing. lines?}
    G -->|Yes| H[Contract is minimal]
    G -->|No| I{Floor still passes?}
    I -->|No| J[Return the last passing version]
    J --> H
    I -->|Yes| H

    H --> K[Output the optimized prompt]
    K --> L[Add Cut and required Note or Assume lines]
    L --> N[Ask: Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]

    N -->|Keep negotiating| E
    N -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| O{Human, live, named signer, full text above?}
    O -->|No| P[Gate stays closed]
    O -->|Yes| R{Execution tools in this session?}
    R -->|No| S[Say the gate is closed]
    R -->|Yes| T[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    T --> U[Execute exactly as written]
    U --> V{Result}
    V -->|Success| W([Done])
    V -->|Failure on a floor item| X[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    X --> E
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: WAIT -> B, WAIT2 -> C
